en: Proverbs 3

p.src: 1  My son, don’t forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments,

ja: れてはならない。 あなたの
en: My son, don’t forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments,
u.src: 1  My son, don’t forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments,

p.src: 2  for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.

en: for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.
u.src: 2  for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.

p.src: 3  Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

ja: しみと真実をあなたから
en: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
u.src: 3  Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

p.src: 4  So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

ja: の目に、 好意と良い評判を
en: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
u.src: 4  So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

p.src: 5  Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.

en: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
u.src: 5  Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.

p.src: 6  In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

en: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
u.src: 6  In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

p.src: 7  Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear the LORD, and depart from evil.

en: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear the LORD, and depart from evil.
u.src: 7  Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear the LORD, and depart from evil.

p.src: 8  It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.

ja: 康となり、 骨を潤すものとなる。
en: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.
u.src: 8  It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.

p.src: 9  Honor the LORD with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase;

en: Honor the LORD with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase;
u.src: 9  Honor the LORD with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase;

p.src: 10  so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.

en: so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.
u.src: 10  so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.

p.src: 11  My son, don’t despise the LORD’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;

ja: の訓練を侮ってはならない。 その叱責を
en: My son, don’t despise the LORD’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;
u.src: 11  My son, don’t despise the LORD’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;

p.src: 12  for whom the LORD loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.

en: for whom the LORD loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.
u.src: 12  for whom the LORD loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.

p.src: 13  Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.

ja: いである。 悟りを得る人も幸いである。
en: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.
u.src: 13  Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.

p.src: 14  For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.

ja: ることにまさり、 その収
en: For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.
u.src: 14  For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.

p.src: 15  She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.

ja: はルビーよりも貴い。 あなたが
むものは何一つ、知恵と
en: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.
u.src: 15  She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.

p.src: 16  Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.

en: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.
u.src: 16  Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.

p.src: 17  Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.

en: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.
u.src: 17  Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.

p.src: 18  She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.

ja: である。 それをしっかり
en: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.
u.src: 18  She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.

p.src: 19  By wisdom the LORD founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.

en: By wisdom the LORD founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.
u.src: 19  By wisdom the LORD founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.

p.src: 20  By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.

en: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.
u.src: 20  By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.

p.src: 21  My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion,

ja: を目から離さず、 それらを
en: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion,
u.src: 21  My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion,

p.src: 22  so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.

en: so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.
u.src: 22  so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.

p.src: 23  Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.

en: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.
u.src: 23  Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.

p.src: 24  When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.

en: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.
u.src: 24  When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.

p.src: 25  Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;

ja: におびえてはならない。
en: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;
u.src: 25  Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;

p.src: 26  for the LORD will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.

en: for the LORD will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.
u.src: 26  for the LORD will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.

p.src: 27  Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.

ja: があなたにあるなら、惜しんではならない。
en: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.
u.src: 27  Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.

p.src: 28  Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.

en: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.
u.src: 28  Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.

p.src: 29  Don’t devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you.

ja: んでいるのに、 その
en: Don’t devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you.
u.src: 29  Don’t devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you.

p.src: 30  Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.

en: Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.
u.src: 30  Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.

p.src: 31  Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.

ja: をうらやんではならない。 その
en: Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.
u.src: 31  Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.

p.src: 32  For the perverse is an abomination to the LORD, but his friendship is with the upright.

en: For the perverse is an abomination to the LORD, but his friendship is with the upright.
u.src: 32  For the perverse is an abomination to the LORD, but his friendship is with the upright.

p.src: 33  The LORD’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.

en: The LORD’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.
u.src: 33  The LORD’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.

p.src: 34  Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.

ja: をあざけり、 へりくだる
en: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.
u.src: 34  Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.

p.src: 35  The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.

en: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.
u.src: 35  The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.
